svg.title: Goat
svg.desc: Standing domestic goat with a short pale coat, narrow face, lateral ears, horns, beard, short tail, and cloven hooves. Biological basis: Goats are used in orthopedic, reproductive, lactation, immunology, and large-animal device studies and are also important antibody-production hosts.
